Let  

\[
a=\log_{2026}x\qquad (x>0),
\]

so \(x=2026^a\).  
Then  

\[
\sqrt[20]{x^{\log_{2026}x}}
=\left((2026^a)^a\right)^{1/20}
=2026^{a^2/20}.
\]

The given equation becomes  

\[
2026^{a^2/20}=26\cdot 2026^a.
\]

Divide by \(2026^a\):

\[
2026^{a^2/20-a}=26.
\]

Taking \(\log_{2026}\) of both sides,

\[
\frac{a^2}{20}-a=\log_{2026}26.
\]

Multiply by \(20\):

\[
a^2-20a-20\log_{2026}26=0.
\]

This quadratic in \(a\) has two real roots \(a_1,a_2\). By Vieta’s formulas,

\[
a_1+a_2=20.
\]

The corresponding positive solutions for \(x\) are  

\[
x_1=2026^{a_1},\qquad x_2=2026^{a_2}.
\]

Hence their product is  

\[
x_1x_2=2026^{a_1+a_2}=2026^{20}.
\]

Now factor \(2026\):

\[
2026=2\cdot 1013,
\]

and \(1013\) is prime (it has no prime divisor \(\le \sqrt{1013}\approx 31.8\)). Thus  

\[
2026^{20}=2^{20}\cdot 1013^{20}.
\]

The number of positive divisors of a number \(p^e q^f\) is \((e+1)(f+1)\). Therefore

\[
d(2026^{20})=(20+1)(20+1)=21^2=441.
\]

\[
\boxed{441}
\]
